THOUGHT Glyph Library — Third Set

Humanist Smooth and Humanist Quantized are now the complete Third Set: conventional closed-outline fonts with the restricted 76-character repertoire.

Declared with metric exception. Both fonts passed visual review, but their approximately 5.6 visual baselines are not drop-in compatible with the baseline-7 contract used by Sets 1 and 2.
